annotations.falsePositiveRisk: View allocation alone does not establish rendered visibility, touch behavior, or usability; the oracle covers only screen containment for the static fixture state.
annotations.rationale: Every admitted exact View allocation is contained by the 1080×2400 screen canvas.

annotations.falsePositiveRisk: A partially outside source allocation can be intentional during animation or carousel behavior; this reviewed static fixture declares the named control as a targeted containment mutation only.
annotations.rationale: The Save View allocation ends at x=1376 while the declared screen ends at x=1080; platform accessibility clipping is retained separately and cannot repair the source fact.

annotations.falsePositiveRisk: Ordinary offscreen scroll content has source allocations below the current screen; mapping it without current global visibility would manufacture failures, and inverted accessibility rectangles are not valid replacement geometry.
annotations.rationale: Visible admitted nodes remain contained; the hidden spacer and offscreen archived nodes produce no core layoutBox or rule result while their native conflict evidence remains in the extension.
